# My IT Dudes

> My IT Dudes is a locally owned IT company in Boca Raton, Florida. For businesses, it provides managed IT services, IT helpdesk support, cybersecurity and ransomware protection, backup and disaster recovery, HIPAA compliance, Microsoft 365, cloud migration, business VoIP phones, managed print and network setup. For homes, it provides PC and laptop repair, virus removal, data recovery, SSD upgrades, custom gaming PC builds, on-site house calls, remote support and patient tech help for seniors. Service is available on-site around Boca Raton and remotely anywhere in South Florida.

- Phone: (561) 555-0142
- Email: hello@myitdudes.com
- Address: Your Street Address, Boca Raton, FL 33431
- Hours: Mon–Fri 9am–6pm, Sat 10am–4pm

## Business IT services
- [Managed IT Services](https://www.myitdudes.com/services#managed-it): outsourced IT department with helpdesk, 24/7 RMM monitoring, patching and planning for offices of 3–100 users.
- [IT Support & Helpdesk](https://www.myitdudes.com/services#it-helpdesk): phone, email, remote and on-site support for employees.
- [IT Strategy, Planning & vCISO](https://www.myitdudes.com/services#it-strategy): roadmaps, budgets, security leadership, office IT relocations.
- [Cybersecurity & Ransomware Protection](https://www.myitdudes.com/services#cybersecurity): EDR, email security, MFA, firewalls and security awareness training.
- [Backup & Disaster Recovery](https://www.myitdudes.com/services#backup-recovery): on-site and cloud backups, tested restores, hurricane-season planning.
- [HIPAA & IT Compliance](https://www.myitdudes.com/services#compliance): risk assessments, encryption and documentation for medical, legal and financial offices.
- [Microsoft 365 & Email Management](https://www.myitdudes.com/services#microsoft-365): setup, migration, security and licensing.
- [Cloud Migration & Hosting](https://www.myitdudes.com/services#cloud-services): server-to-cloud moves, hosted QuickBooks, virtual desktops, file sharing.
- [Business VoIP Phone Systems](https://www.myitdudes.com/services#voip): cloud phones that let you keep your numbers.
- [Managed Print & Printer Support](https://www.myitdudes.com/services#printers): printer and copier setup, scanning and supplies.
- [Business & Home Networks, Wi-Fi](https://www.myitdudes.com/services#wifi-network): firewalls, mesh Wi-Fi and access points.

## Service area
- On-site: Boca Raton, Delray Beach, Highland Beach, Boynton Beach, Deerfield Beach, Parkland, Coconut Creek, Coral Springs
- Remote: all of Palm Beach, Broward and Miami-Dade counties, including Fort Lauderdale, Pompano Beach, West Palm Beach, Hollywood and Miami
